literature_notes: All four ledger lines (L1–L4) describe a single construct: full-length human DSG3 with a c-Myc epitope tag appended at the C-terminus (hDsg3.myc, cloned into pBABE.puro). DSG3 is a type I single-pass transmembrane cadherin: the large ectodomain spans residues 24–627, the single TM helix spans 628–637, and the entire C-terminal cytoplasmic tail spans 638–999. The c-Myc tag therefore sits on the intracellular face and does not qualify as an extracellular surface tag site. No ledger line reports any tag insertion in the extracellular domain, at the mature N-terminus (residue 24), or in any extracellular loop. Because the ledger provides no evidence for an extracellular insertion, sites = [].

literature_other_positions.note: c-Myc epitope tag placed at the C-terminal end of full-length DSG3 (hDsg3.myc construct); the C-terminus (residues 638–999) is intracellular, so this tag is on the cytoplasmic face and cannot serve as an extracellular surface label.
